verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh gives agents a documented API for running its screening pipeline. Customers can be screened synchronously or asynchronously, including in batches. Outcomes are available via a WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook, and cases, alerts and risks can be retrieved and remediated through the API. Ongoing monitoring can be set per customer, and API credentials have configurable permissions and expiry. An OpenAPI schema and llms.txt support agent consumption. However, this is AML screening rather than identity verification: there is no session-based verification flow, no extracted document data, no explicit on-demand re-check endpoint, and no MCP surface. Missing for 10: MCP server, IDV session creation/extracted-data retrieval, explicit re-check trigger, hands-on corroboration of agent operation.
